description: RF-627, P3-21: the planner's answer to the coverage call of a plan run, whichever calls came before it (the harness routes the planner-coverage task to this file). Task 1 builds the order and free shipping features, the order table, operations, journey and screen, task 2 the rest (the customer table and operations, never a feature, so the cancellation card is built on no feature that a requirement cites); it also names a feature that does not exist, a text that is no id and repeats a link, all of which build nothing. Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called.
